name: Open-source implementation evidence
description: Compare public technical claims without assuming benchmarks are comparable.

criteria.label: Concrete implementation
criteria.question: What concrete implementation and supported platform are explicitly described?
criteria.rubric: Select an explicit implementation passage. Unknown when only aspirations or unrelated material are supplied; not applicable when this is not an implementation source.

criteria.label: Reproducibility
criteria.question: What reproducible benchmark method, dataset, hardware and limitations are supplied?
criteria.rubric: Select the most direct methods passage. A performance slogan alone is unknown; not applicable when the source makes no benchmark claim. Never infer comparable hardware or conditions.
